def transform(grid):
    # The figure is four-way symmetric; retain its upper-left 4x4 quadrant.
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row)]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    r0, c0 = min(rows), min(cols)
    height = (max(rows) - r0 + 1) // 2
    width = (max(cols) - c0 + 1) // 2
    return [row[c0:c0 + width] for row in grid[r0:r0 + height]]
